per_rule.rule: S_N must not be null
S_N must be unique across all records
Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
Account_No must not be null
Account_No must be a 4-digit numeric code
Account_No must be unique across all records
Full_Name must not be null
Full_Name should follow title case convention (first letter of each word capitalized)
Full_Name must not contain consecutive whitespace characters (double spaces)
ID must not be null
ID must follow Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, or G), followed by 7 digits, ending with one uppercase checksum letter
JoinDate must not be null
JoinDate must be a parseable datetime value
JoinDate must not be in the future
LastLogin must be a parseable datetime value
JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
SubscriptionFee must not be null
SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a numeric value
SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel value 99999
When Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, 'free', or null
When Subscription_Type is not 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be a positive numeric value greater than 0
Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
AccountBalance must not contain sentinel value 99999.0
AccountBalance must not be negative (unless overdrafts are permitted)
PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
Full_Name must match the corresponding Name in Cust_Bio_dirty (accounting for case and formatting differences such as patronymic particles)
ID must exactly match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
Gender in Cust_Bio_dirty must be consistent with gender-encoding particles in Full_Name (Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female)
FeedbackScore must not contain sentinel placeholder values
